steps.name: Unverified applicant cannot submit qualifications on the hosted site
Verified fixture submits qualifications and private image through the real form
Administrator requests a revision with an applicant-facing reason
Applicant sees the revision reason without administrator-only notes
Applicant resubmits a new qualification/evidence revision
Administrator privately views the uploaded image under hosted CSP
Qualification approval atomically activates teacher access and records checks
Final review physically deletes its private evidence image
Qualified, email-verified teacher opens classroom tools
Protected teacher queries accept the approved qualification revision

limitations: Only synthetic temporary identities and evidence are used.
Email verification for the test identity is set through trusted Auth administration; no verification emails are sent.
PRC/institution references are synthetic fixture records, not actual credential checks.
Human email delivery, institutional verification and usability acceptance remain separate.
